# RentReceipt

> Free, privacy-first financial and legal document suite built for Indian salaried employees, tenants, and small business employers. Generate CBDT-compliant rent receipts, professional salary slips, and legal affidavits with 100% client-side in-browser processing.

RentReceipt provides instant, watermark-free document generation utilities designed to satisfy statutory compliance requirements under the Indian Income Tax Act, 1961 (Section 10(13A), Rule 2A), the Indian Stamp Act, and corporate payroll audits. All data is processed locally in the user's browser memory; zero personal, financial, or tax identifiers are stored or transmitted to server databases.

## Free Compliance Tools

- [Free Rent Receipt Generator](https://rentreceipt.app/#rent-receipt): Generate authentic monthly or multi-month (annual FY 2025-26) rent receipts in PDF format with automatic rupee-in-words conversion, landlord PAN compliance (for rent exceeding ₹1 Lakh/year), and ₹1 revenue stamp placeholders for cash payments over ₹5,000.
- [Online Salary Slip Generator](https://rentreceipt.app/#salary-slip): Create formal employee monthly payslips with comprehensive earnings (Basic, HRA, Conveyance, Special Allowance) and deductions (EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS) alongside net salary calculations and downloadable PDFs for loan/visa/tax filings.
- [Rent Affidavit & Address Proof Generator](https://rentreceipt.app/#affidavit): Create legally formatted rent self-declaration affidavits, no-rent-agreement declarations, and residential address proof documents compatible with e-stamp paper margins for passport, bank account, and employer submissions.
- [QR Code Rent Receipt Verification Portal](https://rentreceipt.app/#verify): Cryptographic authenticity verification portal allowing employers and tax auditors to scan the embedded QR code on generated receipts to verify landlord details, rent amounts, and payment references.

## Guides and Resources

- [HRA Tax Exemption Guide (FY 2025-26)](https://rentreceipt.app/#guide): Step-by-step breakdown of Section 10(13A) House Rent Allowance tax calculation rules, metro (50%) vs. non-metro (40%) ceilings, landlord PAN requirements, paying rent to parents, and Form 12BB employer submission deadlines.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://rentreceipt.app/#faq): Comprehensive answers to common questions regarding revenue stamp validity, landlord PAN exemption limits, multiple-month receipt generation, and client-side privacy architecture.
